description: Common regions of two DNA sequences. mode RightMaximal (default): for each start in sequence2 the single longest substring (length >= minLength) that also occurs in sequence1, distinct strings once, with the first occurrence in sequence1 - not every common substring. mode MaximalExactMatches / MaximalUniqueReference / MaximalUnique = MUMmer -maxmatch / -mumreference / -mum: every maximal exact match (one entry per pair of occurrences), those whose string is unique in sequence1, those unique in both. strands Forward (default) | ReverseComplement | Both (mummer -r / -b): a reverse region is a substring of sequence1 whose reverse complement occurs in sequence2; positionInSecond is then the forward-strand start of that window (mummer -c convention) and isReverseComplement is true; reverse regions follow the forward ones in the order of the reverse-complemented query. IUPAC input (e.g. N runs of an assembly) is accepted: only A/C/G/T match, an N ends every region. Verified against mummer 3.23 (4716 mode x strand cases).

sequence1.description: First nucleotide sequence (the reference): A/C/G/T plus IUPAC codes such as N (case-insensitive).

minLength.description: Minimum common-region length (mummer -l); values below 1 are treated as 1.

mode.description: Which regions (case-insensitive): RightMaximal (default) | MaximalExactMatches | MaximalUniqueReference | MaximalUnique.

strands.description: Which strands of sequence2 (case-insensitive): Forward (default) | ReverseComplement | Both.

includeSequence.description: true (default): every region carries its string. false: coordinates only (positionInFirst, positionInSecond, length), no string is built - the cost of mode RightMaximal is then O(n + m + regions) whatever the region lengths (a poly-A pair of length 20 000 has 20 000 regions of average length 10 000: 200 M characters as strings).

sequence.description: the common string; omitted when includeSequence is false

isReverseComplement.description: true for a region shared with the reverse complement of sequence2 (positionInSecond = forward-strand start of that window); omitted when false

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
